Problem Statement:
Given a number N. There will be N numbers given. Print the smallest number in the given list after each input(Hint use priority queue). 
Input Description:
The input consists of an integer N, followed by N numbers. N is at most 100000. 
Output Description:
The output should be the smallest number in the given list after each input, printed sequentially. 
Sample Input:
4
3 2 4 1 
Sample Output:
3 2 2 1
